The authors propose three specific estimation algorithms: Geometric, Zipfian, and an MLP-based model, each aiming to approximate the full distribution from the partial data. The paper's significance lies in its ability to enable white-box detection methods to work with proprietary LLMs, addressing a critical gap in the field of AI security and text detection.
